title: Covariant differentiable Eckart coordinate jets at nonlinear references
summary: Use a smooth isolated-quaternion local rotation, retain complete coordinate chains and independently qualify them against finite geometry and kinetic covariance, including planar references.
gates: Freeze atom order, isotope masses, reference geometry, source normal vectors, their signs, normalization and every coordinate-map derivative required by the retained potential/property order.

A nonlinear planar reference is valid. Do not differentiate singular vectors of a rank-deficient Cartesian covariance to obtain higher Eckart derivatives. Use the isolated quaternion root with a nonsingular local rotational response.

Use the scalar-positive quaternion patch and four Newton steps only for local derivatives about the identical centered reference. A value-only proper alignment independently supplies finite-geometry values; linear geometries or a non-isolated rotational reference are rejected.

Check the complete first and second coordinate jet against an independent finite-geometry alignment. A first-derivative or Hessian-frequency match alone never qualifies higher derivatives. Reject a failed coordinate-jet audit.

Qualify cubic-order geometry transport through covariance of the full internal/rotation kinetic metric and its first/second derivatives. Numerical differentiation may sample analytic geometry only and must preserve derivative symmetries.

At nonstationary references include the linear force contracted with the fourth coordinate derivative. Transport potential, kinetic and electric-property tensors through a common coordinate map before selecting LAM and SAM sectors.

Keep electronic acquisition and spectral validation separate. No new electronic geometry is implied by a coordinate-jet audit. Preserve completed electronic and analytic-geometry data and the finite-budget DVR protocol.

Freeze protocol and owner content fingerprints, save the independent audit and reject reuse of artifacts whose coordinate-map evidence differs. New scientific rules require a new version and explicit approval.
coordinate_policy: Complete nonredundant vibrational chart and proper rotation at a nonlinear reference; independent value-only alignment; no singular-vector differentiation for higher jets.
backend_policy: Local analytic geometry differentiation and finite geometry audits on the authorized compute host; no electronic callback or automatic spectral acceptance.
